en.headline: Girl, 9, in critical condition with influenza B complications
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the child, who has a long-term illness, developed septic shock and severe pneumonia and had not had this season's flu vaccine.
body: A nine-year-old girl with a long-term illness is in critical condition at Queen Elizabeth Hospital after influenza B infection led to septic shock and severe pneumonia, the Centre for Health Protection said on Saturday.

The centre said the girl developed a fever on Wednesday and a cough and vomiting the next day. She was seen at a private clinic, then taken to the hospital's accident and emergency department and admitted to the paediatric intensive care unit. A respiratory sample tested positive for influenza B. She had not travelled during the incubation period and had not received this season's influenza vaccine. Two household contacts had recent mild fever and upper-respiratory symptoms and have since recovered.

Hong Kong has been in the influenza season since late June, and the centre said activity remains high. Since late June it has recorded 21 severe influenza cases in children, including two critical cases and one death. It expects activity to stay high in the coming weeks as school gatherings increase, and said about 100 schools have already held outreach vaccination sessions, more than at the same point last year.

zh.headline: 9歲女童染乙型流感併發肺炎 情況危殆
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心表示，該名有長期病患的女童出現敗血性休克及嚴重肺炎，尚未接種本季流感疫苗。
body: 衞生防護中心周六表示，一名有長期病患的9歲女童感染乙型流感，併發敗血性休克及嚴重肺炎，現於伊利沙伯醫院兒童深切治療部留醫，情況危殆。
中心指，女童星期三發燒，翌日出現咳嗽和嘔吐，曾到私家診所求診，其後送到伊利沙伯醫院急症室，並獲安排入住兒童深切治療部。呼吸道樣本對乙型流感病毒呈陽性。她在潛伏期內沒有外遊，亦未接種本季季節性流感疫苗。兩名家居接觸者近日曾有輕微發燒和上呼吸道症狀，現已康復。
中心表示，本港自6月底進入流感季節，最新監測顯示整體活躍程度仍處高水平。6月底至今累計21宗兒童嚴重流感個案，包括兩宗危殆及一宗死亡。中心預料未來數周活躍程度仍會偏高，學校爆發個案亦可能增加，並指暫時約有100間學校已舉行外展接種，較去年同期多。
